method: Manual whole-file reading of954-line UiTypes.h; truncated middle reread separately. Pinned bytes verified. No Windows runtime.
findings: GetWindowDpi runtime-resolves GetDpiForWindow and falls back to acquired DC with ReleaseDC and96default. Font and toolbar percentages clamp100..200. Multiplication and MulDiv wrappers do not establish behavior for arbitrary extreme coordinates/DPI.

CRect Width/Height subtract using int64 and clamp to int range; Center adds in int64. Other point arithmetic and manual rectangle deflation use ordinary signed arithmetic, so this is not general saturating geometry.
Language-specific string resource loader bounds-checks block traversal and string lengths against resource byte size; default resource loader uses LoadStringW buffer-reference mode.

Route duplicate validation is debug-only and checks identical route keys, not overlapping ID ranges. MessageTarget stores borrowed spans returned by static Routes; those spans require static lifetime.

GdiObject is move-only and owns DeleteObject; Reset clears handle even if deletion fails. CDC distinguishes owned DC from Borrow and detaches explicitly; owned DC destructor calls DeleteDC. Correct selected-object lifecycle remains caller-dependent.

GdiObjectSelection restores old valid selection; ScopedDcState restores only after successful SaveDC. Attribute scopes restore prior setter result without explicit failure sentinel handling. No failed-GDI-call injection performed.

WindowRef is a borrowed HWND wrapper with mutating operations but no lifetime/ownership guarantee. Many convenience wrappers ignore API error results; rectangle conversions can return unchanged/default data when API calls fail.

CDC FillSolidRect changes DC background color without restoring it itself; callers requiring state isolation need a scope. GetTextExtent returns zero-initialized size if API fails, unlike optional GetTextMetrics/GetClipBox.
WindowCreationScope and current-message/draw contexts are thread_local; global font percentages are ordinary ints. These definitions do not establish arbitrary cross-thread GUI safety.
limits: No native GDI/window/DPI, route dispatch, resource corruption, arithmetic-boundary or lifecycle runtime tests executed.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation deferred. Global completed repository count remains147/500.
